expectation: Histone H3 (total) should be nuclear and present in essentially every nucleated cell, so it should overlay the DAPI nuclei in all cells. Signal tracking cell density (dense epithelium and crypts brightest, sparse stroma dimmer) is expected.
observed: A: epithelium and dense mucosa are bright, sparse stroma and lumen are dark. B and C: yellow sits on the blue nuclei of epithelial and stromal cells (white overlap) and is absent from empty spaces. D: nucleus-sized blobs, most overlapping blue nuclei. C also has bright luminal debris.
why: Yellow signal is nucleus-shaped and overlaps DAPI nuclei across cell types, with dark cell-free spaces, as a ubiquitous nuclear histone should.
notes: Nuclear signal coincides with DAPI nuclei in epithelium and stroma, and cell-free lumen stays dark. Density-following brightness is expected for histone H3. Some bright luminal debris and stromal haze are not tied to cells.
